_doc: Paladin skill definitions (spec #308, one region per ticket): P4 #312 appends rush_paladin, P5 #313 blast and monster_magnet_paladin, P6 #314 charged_blow, P7 #315 and P8 #316 the four Charges and heavens_hammer. Power Strike and Slash Blast are defined by skills/hero.json and are never repeated here (a duplicate key across files is a load error, docs/ARCHITECTURE.md 4.4.4). Until a key is defined here it is inert: never offered or learned.

rush_paladin.name: Rush
rush_paladin.desc: Press the skill key with an arrow key to charge that way, damaging and shoving every monster in your path. Hold to repeat.

text.desc: Press the Rush key with an arrow key to charge that way, damaging and knocking back the monsters in your path. Hold the key to keep charging.

rush_paladin._rush: tier C #312: a copy of rush_hero (H6 #302), the same definition on Paladin's book. Tier A: WZ 1221007 (P1 #309 checked every level row equals 1121006's): rank 1 = WZ level 4 at Lv1, rank 8 = level 30 from Lv16 by the shared balance.mobility_rank_levels rule; damage 78% to 130%, mobCount 15, box lt (-170,-50) to (-250,-50) rb (0,0), action rush2, effect/1..6 and effect0 dust, the Use sound (a UOL to Hero's). Tier C: the same cooldown, knock-back, hold-to-repeat and bot rules as Hero's (GAME_DESIGN 7.33).

charged_blow._provenance: Tier A: Skill.wz 1211002 (book 121) damage 162 to 250 %, prop (stun chance 32 to 90 %), time (stun seconds 2 to 4), range 130 to 150, mobCount 6, hpCon 15 to 25, the effect/{1,2,3,5} and hit/0/{1,2,3,5} art keyed by element (P1 #309: 1 ice, 2 fire, 3 lightning, 5 holy), the mob stun stars and the Use sound; rank 1 reads level 4 (38 %, 2 s). Tier C: it is a Form sub-skill (spec #308, P-3: it stuns in every element and has no freeze variant), the three-mob admission gate, the interval and first_after in each Charge's `subs` entry, the weapon's first swing stance and its 0.6 s display, and `form_sub_of` naming the four Charges. Docs: GAME_DESIGN 7.62.
charged_blow.name: Charged Blow
charged_blow.desc: Slams the monsters around you with the Charge's element, stunning them.

text.desc: While charged, blow away the crowd around you (needs 3 monsters in range) with the Charge's element, stunning them. Costs HP, never the last point.
text.h: Damage {damage}%, up to {mob_count|monster|monsters}; {prop}% chance each to stun for {time} sec.
